responsibilities: Serve as a technical subject matter expert for Google Analytics and enterprise web analytics data.
Design analytics data models that support web traffic, acquisition, engagement, conversion, campaign, and customer behavior analysis.
Develop and maintain reliable data pipelines and transformations for Google Analytics data and related digital marketing sources.
Integrate web behavioral data with customer, booking, sales, marketing, and other enterprise data to enable cross-channel analytics.
Partner with and enable Marketing, Digital, Product, and business stakeholders to translate measurement requirements into scalable analytical datasets.
Establish consistent definitions and reusable data models for sessions, users, traffic sources, campaigns, events, conversions, and digital journeys.
Validate web analytics data quality and reconcile reporting differences across source platforms, analytical datasets, and BI solutions.
Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models for domain-specific solutions based on business requirements, using 3NF and dimensional modeling approaches as appropriate.
Design reusable analytics data products and structures across the Data Warehouse, Data Marts, Data Lakehouse, and Reporting/Analytics layers.
Design and develop modular, reusable ELT transformations that meet data quality, SLA, and performance requirements.
Apply analytics engineering practices including version control, automated testing, documentation, lineage, code review, and CI/CD.
Own data quality, reconciliation, observability, and performance for curated analytical datasets.
Support production analytics data products and resolve data issues across the analytical value chain.
Partner with BI developers and analysts to deliver Power BI semantic models, reports, dashboards, and data agents using trusted analytical datasets.
Contribute to and support Snowflake Cortex and Microsoft Copilot Data Agents by providing governed, well-documented, AI-ready data products.
Partner with Data Governance teams to establish metadata management, lineage, master data management, and data quality standards.
Manage Data Governance (Metadata Mgmt., Data Lineage, Data Quality, Data Access & Security, Data Privacy, Compliance)
Implement architectural controls supporting privacy, security, and retention requirements.
Collaborate with governance and catalog teams to ensure data discoverability and trusted data assets.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Own data quality, reconciliation, observability, and performance for curated analytical datasets
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeat quality, reconciliation, testing, lineage and governance language with no velocity phrasing, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Validate web analytics data quality and reconcile reporting differences
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors would mislead marketing and web reporting at a tour operator; "Compliance" appears only as an item in a governance list, so the risk is business decisions rather than regulation.
evidence.collaboration_width: Marketing; Digital; Product; BI developers; analysts; Data Governance teams; catalog teams
evidence.data_team_maturity: join our growing Data and Analytics Team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A "growing Data and Analytics Team" with BI developers, analysts and governance teams already in place, plus "enterprise data modernization initiatives", points to a function that exists and is scaling.
evidence.jd_authorship: Establish consistent definitions and reusable data models for sessions, users, traffic sources, campaigns, events, conversions, and digital journeys.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The web analytics bullets name GA4 entities and specific products like "Snowflake Cortex and Microsoft Copilot Data Agents"; the governance bullets are more generic, but specificity dominates.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with and enable Marketing, Digital, Product, and business stakeholders
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The first and largest responsibilities block serves web, digital and marketing analytics (acquisition, campaign, conversion), so commercial.
evidence.autonomy_level: Serve as a technical subject matter expert for Google Analytics
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns the GA4 and modelling domain ("Own data quality", "Establish consistent definitions") while also delivering for marketing ("Support production analytics data products", "Contribute to and support").
evidence.ai_role: providing governed, well-documented, AI-ready data products
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate supplies data products that Snowflake Cortex and Copilot data agents consume, so AI sits downstream of their work.
evidence.testing_framing: Own data quality, reconciliation, observability, and performance for curated analytical datasets
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and automated testing are framed as responsibilities the candidate owns.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: design and develop trusted, scalable data analytics products
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust leads the job summary and recurs ("trusted analytical datasets", "trusted data assets") alongside privacy and compliance controls, so the fear is untrustworthy data reaching decision-makers.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Design-new verbs sit alongside "Develop and maintain" and "Support production" work on existing pipelines, so mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters in Pawtucket, RI.
evidence.loss_aversion: "We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on, and strategic Analytics Engineer to design and develop trusted, scalable data analytics products." frames trust as the role's primary output.
